The type-safe window function API has been implemented and committed to the `feat/window-functions` branch.

### Key Changes
- **Window Functions & Frame Utilities** ([`drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts)):
  - **Ranking**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L368), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L376), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L384), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L392), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L404), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L412).
  - **Offset & Value Access**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L420), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L442), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L464), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L474), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L484).
  - **Aggregates**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L496), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L504), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L512), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L520), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L528) (emits `count(*)` when called with no arguments).
  - **Frame Builder & Boundary Helpers**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L318), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L326), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L292), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L305), and constants [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L286), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L288), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L290).
  - Re-exported from [`drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts) and top-level `drizzle-orm`.
- **Query Builders & Dialects**:
  - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` method and `WINDOW` clause generation before `ORDER BY` across `pg-core`, `mysql-core`, `sqlite-core`, `singlestore-core`, and `gel-core`.
  - Added validation rejecting empty or whitespace-only window names.
- **Validation & Constraint Rules**:
  - Offsets and tile counts are emitted as raw SQL literals rather than bound parameters.
  - `ntile` and `nthValue` reject non-positive integer arguments with messages containing the helper name and value.
  - `preceding` and `following` reject negative or non-integer arguments.
  - `rows` and `range` validate boundary order (`from` boundary ordered after `to` boundary throws an error referencing `"from"`).
  - Value-access functions return nullable types (`T | null`), and `lag`/`lead` strip nullability when a default value is supplied.
- **Verification**:
  - Full test suite passed: 14 test files, 578 unit tests ([`drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts)).
  - Type tests passed with 0 errors ([`drizzle-orm/type-tests/pg/window.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6h81zkjm/drizzle-orm/type-tests/pg/window.ts)).
  - Committed to branch `feat/window-functions`.
